text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A victory in the Takarazuka Kinen. And as 
if in response to that fierce run, her 
father's medical condition also begins to 
improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry about her family 
anymore. As the Second-Generation 
Lightning inheriting her father's 
lightning, Tamamo Cross heads toward a new 
battle: the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
